verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Open WebUI as a self-hosted AI platform built to run entirely offline. They document running it on Docker, Kubernetes, pip or bare metal, a one-command quick start, and air-gapped deployment, and the GitHub README lists pip, uv, Docker and Kubernetes (helm/kustomize) installs. Community users confirm they run it themselves, though they complain about very large Docker images, and the custom BSD-3 license adds branding clauses that complicate forking but not self-hosting. Missing for 10: lightweight deployment (Docker images criticized as oversized, heavy dependencies pulled even when only using external APIs), clean permissive-license openness for forks.
